card.name: Linking words before biologic drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as receiving, of, with, every or a that come right before a biologic or immune-therapy drug name or a dosing interval. Seen in labels for biologics (TALTZ, DUPIXENT, NUCALA, Enbrel) and in cancer treatment lists.

modes.label: Before a biologic drug name
modes.description: The word 'receiving', 'of' or 'with' sits just before the name of an antibody or biologic drug.

modes.label: Dosing interval or treatment list
modes.description: A space or comma in a dosing schedule or in a list of cancer treatments, where a biologic may come next.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like biological, biology and immune, so a biologic or immune therapy is expected next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a biologic drug or immune-therapy term is likely to appear.
